lead: A real dl with real dt and dd pairs, so a screen reader announces each description as belonging to its term. Two, three or four across, up to forty rows.

entries.title: The term
entries.text: It is set in the semibold weight so the two sides stay distinguishable when the list runs long.

entries.title: The value
entries.text: Short by design — the child field caps it at twenty-four characters.

entries.title: The explanation
entries.text: When the pair needs more than a value, this longer line sits under it at the supporting size.

entries.title: The rule
entries.text: Drawn under each row rather than around the list, so the eye can run down either column.
